Individualized Care Why Come to Clearwater Dentist?

Clearwater Dentist is a practice that focuses on oral health, providing individualized dental treatment and making you feel your best with the latest technology. We want to make your visit to our dental office the best one you've ever had and to have you feeling and looking your best. Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya is a talented dentist who specializes in minimally invasive aesthetic and functional treatments for all dental procedures, giving you the best dental experience.


We want to make you proud of yourself and feel confident again if you are hiding your smile, or if you feel your age has negatively affected your appearance. Clearwater Dentist welcomes you and all your family members. We look forward to building a lasting friendship with you.

Meet The Doctor

Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya

“I love working as a dentist. I love my patients, and I love my staff. The reason I come to work is to see my patients excitement after getting beautiful and healthy smiles back.


So many people do not smile because they are embarrassed of what their teeth look like. So many people have pain in their teeth. This makes people unhappy, and effects their entire life - they get depressed, they have trouble getting a good job, they can’t fully participate in life.


I am so lucky to be excellent at giving people beautiful smiles, and getting them out of pain. I simply love that I can help people, and make them happy. I love when my patients smile after the visit!”

High Quality and Professional Dental Services

Our expert team at Clearwater Dentist has provided dental services with pride for many years. Our experience will help you reach your dental health goals. Our experienced dentists are all members of the American Dental Association, so they can give you the latest information about your dental health.


Our team is friendly and helpful to both existing and new patients. For your dental needs you can easily schedule an appointment at our Clearwater, FL location 1700 N. McMullen Booth Rd for an amazing experience. We believe that your first visit with us will be informative and you will leave feeling confident about the choice you made by choosing our team of dentists.


Our Dental Services

Clearwater Dentist offers a variety of services to help you maintain your oral health. We are specialists in implant dentistry and general dentistry. Also, we offer root canal and gum disease treatments. We offer comprehensive cleaning services that are tailored to your needs. Our emergency dental care is available 24/7 to meet your needs.


We are proud to provide our patients with beautiful, healthy smiles. We would love for you to be the next. Come down to see why our team is highly recommended. We have a friendly team that will make sure you leave with a smile and a wonderful experience. Please contact us to schedule an appointment. We are excited to help you achieve the best possible oral health!

 Clearwater Dentist Services

Smile Makeover

Dental Implants

Our Smile Makeover treatments will give you an incredibly beautiful smile. Our experienced dentist can improve the size, color or shape of teeth, and reduce wrinkles. A smile makeover can include one or several treatments, and you will be proud to show it off.


Learn More

Our experienced dentist will use her artistic abilities to create beautiful, new teeth that you can enjoy for the rest of your life. If you take care of your dental implant, you can have them for the rest of your lifetime. Most people won't even know that you ever had a missing tooth!
